description:
In this video, we will discuss how to talk to customers or clients on the phone in BPO in Hindi with Garima Saini (customer se kaise baat karen phone par). She is talking about telephone etiquette or telecalling tips in hindi and giving telecalling or call center training training in hindi. That will help us for how to convince or speak to customer or clients on call in call centers or BPO sector. It will increase sales of outbound call, inbound call or cold calling. selling on call is not a easy task. This telephone etiquette will improve our sales.

Garima is a Business Development Executive in a Software Company. She is an experienced salesperson and has a lot of sales knowledge.
